sites.name: Göbeklitepe Ören Yeri
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Listed as a state museum or archaeological site (ören yeri) on the Ministry of Culture and Tourism fee table.

access.opening: Opening hours not stated on the fee table read.
access.tickets: Foreign visitors €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026); Müzekart accepted. Animation centre (Canlandırma Merkezi) is a separate €3 ticket.
access.permits: No permit stated; entry by ticket.
